The relationship between tcc and lst 2013-2021
```{r}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_tcc.R")

for (i in 2013:2021){
  rs_tcc <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/nlcd_tcc_NY_",i,".tif"))
  rs_lst <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/",i,".tif")) %>%
    projectRaster(., rs_tcc, method = "ngb")

  output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/tcc_lst_",i,".jpg")
  scatters(tree= rs_tcc, lst = rs_lst,xlabel = '', output_file = output_dir)
}

```
